Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 and mechanism action_type 'PARTIAL AGONIST'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (as target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
